items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: And they had a boy they used to call Albert Murphy.

ctx.x: Is there anything else you can tell about Simon? How he got started on base? Did your father help him? Did you tell us?

Well, he helped him in the later years. When Simon got started on base, we lived on Bourbon Street, Bourbon and Marais. He took one of those, I won't say soap boxes, but it was a, the thin stuff, but it was a milk can box. Yeah. Old Magnolia box. And they had a boy they used to call Albert Murphy. The old cheese box, the cheese used to come around. He made a drum out of that. Yeah, I see those, yeah. But Simon made a bass. That's how he started. Made his own instrument. Made his own instrument. And from then on,…
How old do you suppose he was until then?
